set -euo pipefail; SB=$HOME/.cache/fred-codex-helper-sandbox-20260913; mkdir -p $HOME/.local/bin; install -m 0700 "$SB/omega-mcp-headers" $HOME/.local/bin/omega-mcp-headers; test "$(sha256sum "$SB/omega-mcp-headers" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$(sha256sum $HOME/.local/bin/omega-mcp-headers | awk '{print $1}')"; if codex mcp get omega-frankenstein --json >/dev/null 2>&1; then codex mcp remove omega-frankenstein >/dev/null; fi; codex mcp add omega-frankenstein --url http://127.0.0.1:8789/mcp --bearer-token-env-var OMEGA_MCP_TOKEN >/dev/null; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path.home()/'.codex/config.toml'
s=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
old='bearer_token_env_var = "OMEGA_MCP_TOKEN"'
new='http_headers_helper = "/home/ai-core-node/.local/bin/omega-mcp-headers"\nrequired = true\nstartup_timeout_sec = 3.0\ntool_timeout_sec = 30.0'
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('expected Codex MCP auth anchor missing')
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1),encoding='utf-8')
PY
printf '%s\n' '--- codex get ---'; codex mcp get omega-frankenstein --json; printf '%s\n' '--- helper retest ---'; $HOME/.local/bin/omega-mcp-headers | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d.get('Authorization','').startswith('Bearer '); print('PASS credential=REDACTED')"; printf 'materialized_sha='; sha256sum $HOME/.local/bin/omega-mcp-headers | awk '{print $1}'
